استأوين (form X)
# اِسْتَأْوَيْنَ (istaʔwayna) /is.taʔ.waj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَأْوَى (istaʔwā)
# اِسْتَأْوِينَ (istaʔwīna) /is.taʔ.wiː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَأْوَى (istaʔwā)
